_doc: film.json for the booth-trailer template (build_film.py reads it). Every v5 hook is ON; each is opt-in by key, so delete a key to
fall back to v4 behaviour. skin: tools/skin_apply.py -> scenes/skin_data.js (+ design.md tokens) before lint/render; the head fade
plate is the skin's black token. captions.ass: tools/captions_ass.py writes .ass + .srt + .vtt from the same caption groups the
lane burns in (overrides: optional captions_overrides.json). chapters: tools/chapters.py from STORYBOARD.md + seams.json + the
narration; merge 'auto' = --merge when the film is under 60 s. sfx.auto: audio/sfx_synth.py once (audio/sfx/) + audio/sfx_place.py
from out/timeline.json (seams + block sync points) and sync.json (hand-authored flash/stamp/climax points; 'force': true per point
skips the word guard for that cue) -> out/sfx_<name>.wav mixed under the carved bed with the bus gain already in the stem.
fx.buses: audio/fx_chain.py chains per bus (voice after voice_preset, bed before the carve, sfx before the mix). bed_env: audio/
envelope.py breathe -3 dB at every cut + swell under the riser (swell: 'climax' = the sync.json climax point, a number, or null).
name: film
